findings.summary: When the verdict has a prNumber and the caller passes no prNumber, the guard lets the retirement through. Both current callers always pass a prNumber, so this is not reachable today. Failing closed in that case would be safer if a third caller is added.

findings.summary: When the failed verdict records no prNumber, an older landing record that has neither kind nor headBranch still retires the verdict, just as before this change. That matches AC-3 and is not a security issue. A later backfill could close it sooner.
